title: Best Position for a Service Centre
description: Find the point that minimizes the total geometric distance to all delivery locations.
pseudocode:
1. Set x, y to average of all coordinates
2. Set step = 10.0, eps = 1e-7
3. While step > eps:
4.   For each direction in neighbors:
5.     If new distance < current distance, move there
6.   Else, step *= 0.5
7. Return current minimum distance

steps.note: Checking neighbors with current step size.
Found a better point, updating coordinates.
Step size reduced to improve precision.
